proper_mixed_definition: At least one but fewer than all cubic monomials reduced; this arm is conditional on this domain, not the unrestricted selector winner.
equal_effort_optimizer: COBYLA, tol=1e-12, then deterministic uniform completion only if early stop
initialisation: Same three independently seeded uniform (gamma,beta) starts for every representation and warming policy on an instance
objective: Exact expectation of original f(x), marginalising all auxiliary variables
primary_contrast: For each family, cold p0 minus warm-native p0 is classical preparation; warm-native p0 minus warm-native p1 under 360 equal-effort calls is incremental evolution. The latter is the prespecified QAOA contrast.
secondary_contrasts: native/proper_mixed/full ranking under equal effort and scanned refinement
inference: Paired instance-level mean, 10000 percentile bootstrap replicates, 95% intervals; secondary intervals descriptive without multiple-testing correction
exclusions: No exclusion based on performance. Generation retries only to require at least two nonzero cubic supports for defining a proper-mixed arm. Every attempted seed and reason retained.
scope: Fresh locally frozen evaluation, not externally preregistered; n=6 noiseless p=1 only. Previous 14/20/18 instance sets are exploratory; enriched instances are mechanism studies. No quality threshold or quantum advantage claim. Dense scan and refinement are a sensitivity check, not a proof of global convergence.
